use default
use Raster.ANIMATION
use Raster.IMAGE

use Grid = List[string]

let cell = 20
let margin = 10
let frames = 24

read(path: string) -> Grid is
    let lines = IO.File.read_all_lines(path)
    let width = lines |> map(line => line.length) |> reduce(0, int.max)

    lines |> map(line => line.pad_right(width)) |> collect_list()
si

heads_around(grid: Grid, row: int, column: int) -> int =>
    (row - 1::row + 1)
        |> flat_map(r => (column - 1::column + 1) |> map(c => (r, c)))
        |> filter(((r, c)) =>
            r >= 0 /\ r < grid.count /\ c >= 0 /\ c < grid[r].length /\
            grid[r][c] == 'H')
        |> count()

next(grid: Grid, row: int, column: int) -> char =>
    case grid[row][column]
    when 'H' then 't'
    when 't' then '.'
    when '.' then
        let heads = heads_around(grid, row, column) in
        if heads == 1 \/ heads == 2 then 'H' else '.' fi
    else ' '
    esac

step(grid: Grid) -> Grid =>
    (0..grid.count)
        |> map(row =>
            (0..grid[row].length)
                |> map(column => next(grid, row, column))
                |> join(""))
        |> collect_list()

draw(image: IMAGE, grid: Grid) is
    image.clear(30ub, 30ub, 34ub)

    for (row, line) in grid |> index() do
        for (column, state) in line |> index() do
            case state
            when 'H' then image.colour(80ub, 150ub, 255ub)
            when 't' then image.colour(240ub, 90ub, 60ub)
            when '.' then image.colour(235ub, 190ub, 60ub)
            else continue
            esac

            let x = cast double(margin + column * cell)
            let y = cast double(margin + row * cell)

            image.fill_rectangle(
                x + 1.0D, y + 1.0D,
                x + cast double(cell) - 1.0D, y + cast double(cell) - 1.0D)
        od
    od
si

let grid mut = read("sample.wire")

let width = 2 * margin + cell * grid[0].length
let height = 2 * margin + cell * grid.count

let image = IMAGE(width, height)
let animation = ANIMATION(width, height)

for generation in 0..frames do
    if generation < 4 then
        write_line("generation {generation}:")
        grid |> each(line => write_line("  |{line}|"))
        write_line("")
    fi

    draw(image, grid)
    animation.add(image, 150)

    grid = step(grid)
od

animation.write("wireworld.png")

animation.show("wireworld.png")
